tmp.text: The Stronghold is the fortress that the rebel Eladamri tries and fails to take: after his wife died in a fire likely set by Stronghold agents, he led a frontal assault but could not breach the Portcullis and called a retreat.

Eladamri was later captured inside, tortured by Greven, and escaped, while Greven, who had abandoned his people to join the Stronghold's oppressors, was ordered by Volrath to intercept the Weatherlight.

After the Weatherlight smashed Predator into the Stronghold and escaped, Volrath vanished and the fortress fell into chaos; Crovax later returned to slaughter the hostages and was crowned after beating Volrath in a duel.

sth.text: The Stronghold is where Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew journey through Volrath's Stronghold, battling Volrath's creations to rescue their imprisoned comrades, and the set's cards describe [[Volrath's Stronghold]] as the seed of a world's evil.

exo.text: The Stronghold is the way out for the Weatherlight crew, who after rescuing Sisay and pieces of the Legacy must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.
At the same time the Skyshroud elves and the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes assault it.

nem.text: In Nemesis, the Stronghold falls into a struggle over who will be evincar: Belbe restores order and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai, preferring Ertai, but Crovax organizes a coup and Belbe is forced to crown him after a showdown with Ertai and the returning Volrath.

Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia and plans to cut flowstone production, yet Crovax rules harshly, and by the end the flowstone machinery runs at full operation and the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.

apc.text: In Apocalypse, the Stronghold, now Phyrexian central command in a dormant volcano in Urborg, is besieged by a coalition, and Gerrard lands in its throne room where a crazed Crovax stands over Squee.
Gerrard kills Crovax, but Yawgmoth emerges as a Black Cloud of Death and the allies flee on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
Stone dwarves erupt the volcano and destroy it, though its portal had already let Yawgmoth enter Dominaria.

dom.text: Sixty years after the Mending, Belzenlok's Cabal takes the Stronghold and raises it again with Bogardan lava mages, and Liliana vows to pry it open and destroy his legacy.
The Blackblade is locked inside, so Teferi slows time and Gideon and Chandra walk past frozen guards, but when the spell ends they are swept into the fighting pit arena.
Chandra frees the prisoners, Radha kills Whisper, and Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault.
Outside the Stronghold, Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him.
